decides: 出多大、什么比例——载体决定比例，比例反过来约束构图。这是铁律层，不为风格让步

items.prompt: square 1:1 frame, subject centered with symmetric margins, safe for avatar and icon crops
items.note: 头像、图标、周边图案默认

items.prompt: portrait 3:4 frame, vertical emphasis with the figure or title occupying the upper two thirds, stable for illustration and light novel plates
items.note: 插画与轻小说彩页默认

items.prompt: landscape 16:9 frame, broadcast and cinematic default, horizon placed on the upper or lower third, side margins clear of critical shapes
items.note: 动画帧与视频封面默认

items.prompt: full-screen vertical 9:16 frame, built for phone scrolling, top third reserved for the hook, bottom third clear of essential detail under UI overlay zones
tall 2:3 poster frame, vertical thrust with generous sky or ceiling, title band across the upper third, stable for print and key visual
ultra-wide 21:9 cinematic frame, extreme horizontal recession with layered depth planes, subject small against the environment scale
items.note: 宽银幕专属：史诗感来自比例本身
